title: Send finished work to the verifier after an incomplete send-back report
summary: When the producer's report is still incomplete after the one send-back, run.rs fails the job ("still had problems when sent back"). Change it so that if the producer made changes, the work and last report go to the verifier, with the unreported criteria flagged, and only a no-change result fails. Audience: Athena operators whose jobs (e.g. 582g) failed over report gaps.

defaults_applied.how: Tests added for the new path; cargo test and clippy criterion.
Criteria run the lifecycle scenario rather than checking wiring.
Change the send-back's give-up policy rather than special-casing job 582g.
Decision entry and CHANGELOG written for outside readers.
One focused change in the send-back path.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: The fix is in the send-back loop in crates/athena-core/src/run.rs (~lines 714-723).
Missing real full-test result after send-back also goes to the verifier, which can run cargo test itself; only 'no change' fails.
I did not read the other five jobs' records; they are absent from my copy.

acceptance_criteria.text: A lifecycle test in which the producer, on the send-back pass, reports only some criteria but leaves real changes reaches the verifier and does not end in the 'still had problems when sent back' failure; run `cargo test`.
A test where the producer makes no change after send-back still fails the job; run `cargo test`.

The unreported or unmet criteria and any missing test result from the last report are kept in the attempt invocation's detail and passed to the verifier as context, so the verifier judges them rather than the self-check.
The send-back prompt text in run.rs no longer says a still-missing criterion fails the job, and matches the new behavior.
A CHANGELOG line and a decision entry record the change and why, citing job 582g.
`cargo test`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --check` all pass.

out_of_scope: Changing how many send-backs are allowed (PRODUCER_SEND_BACKS)
Diagnosing the other five failed jobs individually
Changing the verifier's own criteria checks
departures: Slightly higher cost and lower pass chance than reference: touches core run loop and needs new lifecycle tests.
